preExecutionFindings.title: Design disagreements
preExecutionFindings.observedProblem: The first design retained open questions about money ownership, period precedence, old evidence attribution and mixed providers. R01 later exposed a fresh-public-quote eligibility inconsistency between design and first authored expectations.
preExecutionFindings.resolution: Exact outputs were shared; draft02 was unanimously approved. R01 separately received explicit all3 agreement on same-clause/applicable-heading evidence, no completed-adjacent-clause inheritance, and independent old-owned correction.

preExecutionFindings.title: Initial Main diagnostic defects
preExecutionFindings.observedProblem: Nonmonetary exclusions could drop the annual prefix; review cadence masking could remove the year from a resulting salary; same-band references could lose CAD.
preExecutionFindings.resolution: Preserve exclusions, separate review nouns from resulting-salary verbs, retain owned same-band currency.

preExecutionFindings.title: Historical corpus regressions
preExecutionFindings.observedProblem: Early candidates lost coordinated disclosures and compensation headings, confused OTE/base expansions and shared hourly units, or copied geography across sentences. A later broad structured inclusion predicate incorrectly demoted182 Anthropic comparable jobs; another version relabelled54 Scale rows through plural packages.
preExecutionFindings.resolution: Per-item source inspection caught these despite sometimes unchanged aggregate counts. Fix subject ownership, preserve bounded geography and shared context, and exclude separate/conditional packages. Preserve every candidate report.

preExecutionFindings.title: Independent implementation blockers B01-B04 and M01
preExecutionFindings.observedProblem: Lost original incomplete-input cardinality could create a false comparable salary; a bonus could hide an actual malformed salary or recovery. Included/excluded component objects and qualified amounts could become salary while whole combined-salary predicates could be rejected. D.C. splitting lost geographic constraints; blanket note restoration retained obsolete variants.
preExecutionFindings.resolution: Keep exact legacy incomplete warning as unresolved; evaluate actual inputs before rejection; require directly attached raw component-value relation with bounded qualifiers; preserve complete combined salary. Protect D.C. and restore only the actual legacy incomplete note.

preExecutionFindings.title: Authored integration blockers B05-B07
preExecutionFindings.observedProblem: A500-character display label lost supported old attributes despite a complete owned native title. Unconditional same-range OTE stayed comparable base. Board-only incomplete notes from other providers were replaced by a generic note.
preExecutionFindings.resolution: Separate title attribution from completeness, recognize unconditional OTE while preserving conditional control, preserve exact positively established four-provider board-only payloads. Require independent correction review and paired provenance/cap tests.
